summary: The Technology Director for Mansfield Public Schools urges preservation of the E-Rate program to ensure affordable broadband and Wi-Fi access for students and teachers.

claims.argument: E-Rate has made significant technology investments possible
claims.evidence_quote: E-Rate has made it possible for us to make significant technology investments that would otherwise have been out of reach for our budget, and those investments are the foundation of how our students learn and how our teachers teach every day.
